# OpenCV.js 4.11.0

Unmodified [official single-file runtime](https://docs.opencv.org/4.11.0/opencv.js), including embedded WASM. Loaded only when the user explicitly starts the experimental cutout, from a same-origin Worker. The bundled Apache 2.0 and third-party license texts and SHA-256/source details accompany the runtime. See [implementation notes](../../../../docs/player-card-grabcut.md).
